intro: 3 pieces of cream crackers have about 160 kcal. Most of the calories come from wheat flour and vegetable oil in the dough.

variants.name: Cream crackers dipped in teh tarik (1 glass)

diet: Yes, cream crackers can fit into a weight loss plan. The catch is they're low in protein, so you get hungry again fast. Eating straight from the tin, 3 can easily become 6-8 pieces. Count them as a snack, not a full breakfast.
tips: Take 3 pieces, put them on a plate, then close the tin and keep it away.
Eat with a boiled egg or a glass of less-sugar milk for protein so you stay fuller.
Dip in kopi O or teh O kurang manis, not teh tarik or thick milo.

swap.name: 2 cream crackers + 1 boiled egg
swap.why: Almost the same calories, but with protein from the egg. Keeps you full until your next meal.

faq.q: Are cream crackers good for breakfast?
faq.a: Can, but on their own they're low in protein. Add an egg, milk or a little peanut butter for a more balanced breakfast.

faq.q: Are cream crackers healthier than white bread?
faq.a: About the same in calories. Cream crackers usually have more fat and salt, white bread has more carbs. Both are okay if the portion is controlled.

faq.q: Why do cream crackers make me hungry fast?
faq.a: They're mostly refined carbs, low in fibre and protein. Pair them with a protein source to stay full longer.
